newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: FPHC taps Morgan Grenfell as adviser.
newsitem.headline: FPHC taps Morgan Grenfell as adviser.

text.p: Utility-based conglomerate First Philippine Holdings Corp said on Monday it has appointed Deutsche Morgan Grenfell to help it raise funds to bankroll its projects.
In a statement to the Philippine Stock Exchange, the company said Morgan Grenfell will assist in "the fund-raising requirements for its power and other projects".
The arrangement is still subject to the approval of its board and shareholders, the statement said.
First Philippine Holdings is also involved in oil exploration, power generation, real estate development and tollway construction.
